SELECT c.contract_number, c.trade_id, c.traded_price, c.active_lots, c.settle_price, c.average_till_now, c.averaging_startdate, c.averaging_enddate, c.mult_factor, c.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.contract_number IN ('BFA_CT_053', 'BFA_CT_051', 'BFA_CT_058', 'BFA_CT_003') ORDER BY c.contract_number, c.trade_id
SELECT security_id, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date = :valueDate
SELECT security_id, settle_price FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND value_date = :valueDate

SELECT v.security_id, v.value_date, v.settle_price, v.created_by, v.created_timestamp, v.updated_by, v.updated_timestamp FROM opera.security_settlement_value_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = 'CFS' AND v.value_date BETWEEN :valueDate - 7 AND :valueDate AND v.security_id LIKE 'CM OR %' ORDER BY v.security_id, v.value_date

SELECT security_id, value_date, settle_price FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(:valueDate, INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND :valueDate AND security_id LIKE 'CM OR %' ORDER BY security_id, value_date

SELECT tenant_id, invenio_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM opera.product_master_table WHERE invenio_product_code LIKE 'CM OR%' AND (tenant_id = :tenant OR tenant_id IS NULL)
SELECT invenio_product_code, currency, lot_mult, constant_curr_mult, curr_mult_factor, murex_mult, price_conv_factor FROM dbsystemuat.product_master_table WHERE invenio_product_code LIKE 'CM OR%'

SELECT c.client_code, c.contract_number, d.security_id, c.active_lots, c.traded_price, c.settle_price, c.mtm_nc, c.mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.business_unit = c.business_unit AND d.trade_id = c.trade_id AND d.is_latest_version = 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND d.security_id LIKE 'CM OR %' ORDER BY c.client_code, c.contract_number

SELECT d.instrument, CASE WHEN d.contract_number IS NULL OR d.contract_number = '' THEN 'no contract' ELSE 'contract' END AS contract, count(*) AS trades, min(d.trade_id) AS example_trade, min(d.premium) AS example_price FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_cfs d JOIN (SELECT a.trade_id FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs a JOIN (SELECT trade_id, max(value_date) AS value_date FROM dbsystemuat.deal_active_lots_table_cfs WHERE value_date <= :valueDate GROUP BY trade_id) m ON m.trade_id = a.trade_id AND m.value_date = a.value_date WHERE a.active_lots != 0) l ON l.trade_id = d.trade_id WHERE d.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND d.transaction_date < :valueDate AND d.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400' AND abs(d.premium - round(d.premium, 4)) > 0.000000001 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

WITH lal AS ( SELECT trade_id FROM opera.latest_active_lot WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND active_lots <> 0 ), dt AS ( SELECT dt.trade_id, count(*) AS latest_rows, count(DISTINCT dt.premium) AS prices, max(dt.premium) AS premium FROM opera.deal_ticket_table dt WHERE dt.tenant_id = :tenant AND dt.is_latest_version = 1 AND dt.trade_id IN (SELECT trade_id FROM lal) GROUP BY dt.trade_id ) SELECT c.instrument, CASE WHEN c.contract_number IS NULL OR c.contract_number = '' THEN 'no contract' ELSE 'contract' END AS contract, CASE WHEN dt.trade_id IS NULL THEN 'no latest deal ticket row' WHEN dt.prices > 1 THEN 'deal ticket has several prices' WHEN abs(dt.premium - round(dt.premium::numeric, 4)::double precision) <= 0.000000001 THEN 'deal ticket also 4 decimals' WHEN round(dt.premium::numeric, 4) <> c.premium THEN 'deal ticket price differs' ELSE 'full price used' END AS price_path, count(*) AS trades, min(c.trade_id) AS example_trade FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c JOIN lal ON lal.trade_id = c.trade_id LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.trade_id = c.trade_id WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.is_latest_version = 1 AND c.subportfolio LIKE 'RMS%' AND c.transaction_date < :valueDate AND c.counterparty_parent <> 'JPM9A400' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC

SELECT c.trade_id, c.instrument, c.contract_number, c.counterparty_parent, c.premium AS clone_premium, dt.premium AS deal_premium, dt.is_latest_version, dt.version_no FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c LEFT JOIN opera.deal_ticket_table dt ON dt.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND dt.trade_id = c.trade_id WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.is_latest_version = 1 AND c.trade_id IN ('TR-FY-2026-292041', 'TR-FY-2026-288367', 'TR-FY-2026-244400', 'TR-FY-2026-254564', 'TR-FY-2026-172471') ORDER BY c.trade_id, dt.version_no
